<div align="center">
    <h1>
        Zabbix Proxmox Backup Server Template
    </h1>
    <h4>
        Agentless monitoring of Proxmox Backup Server via the HTTP API
    </h4>
    <br>
</div>
<br>
<br>

<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *** BODY ************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
## Description
This template monitors Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) over its REST API. It is agentless - all data is
collected by the Zabbix server (or proxy) using an API token, no external scripts or agent are
required on the PBS host.

See the [PBS API documentation](https://pbs.proxmox.com/docs/api-viewer/index.html) for details.

## What is monitored
- **API availability** - HTTP status of the `/version` endpoint, plus the PBS version string.
- **Host metrics** (`/nodes/localhost/status`) - CPU utilization, CPU cores, load average
  (1/5/15 min), memory total/used and utilization %, swap total/used, root filesystem total/used
  and utilization %, uptime and kernel version.
- **Datastores** - discovered automatically via low-level discovery (`/status/datastore-usage`).
  For each datastore: total/used/available space, used %, estimated full date, error state,
  garbage collection status (removed bytes, pending chunks) and configured GC schedule, backup
  group count, total snapshot count, total backup size, latest backup time/age/duration and the
  number of failed backups in the last 24 hours.

## Triggers
- API service not available (HIGH)
- High CPU utilization / High memory utilization / Root filesystem low on free space (WARNING)
- Host has been restarted (INFO)
- Per datastore: high space usage, error reported, estimated full within 7 days, latest backup too
  old, no backup groups, failed backups in the last 24h (HIGH)

A dashboard **Proxmox Backup Server overview** (API status, version, CPU, memory, uptime, and
per-datastore storage/backup graph prototypes) is included.

## Requirements
- **Zabbix 7.0 or higher**
- Proxmox Backup Server **3.x or 4.x** (tested)
- Network access from the Zabbix server/proxy to the PBS API port (default `8007`)
- An API token with read-only (`Audit` / `DatastoreAudit`) privileges

## Setup
### 1. Create a monitoring user and API token
For security reasons create a dedicated user under **Configuration -> Access Control - User
Management** and generate an API token for it. Assign these permissions to both the user and the
token:

| Path         | Role            | Propagate |
|--------------|-----------------|-----------|
| `/`          | `Audit`         | 1         |
| `/datastore` | `DatastoreAudit`| 1         |
| `/system`    | `Audit`         | 1         |

The `/system` Audit role is required for the host metrics (`/nodes/.../status`), `/datastore`
DatastoreAudit for the datastore and backup data.

### 2. Import the template
Import [`template_proxmox_backup_server_7.0.yaml`](./7.0/template_proxmox_backup_server_7.0.yaml)
and link it to the PBS host.

### 3. Configure host macros
Set the following macros on the host:

| Macro                            | Description                                       | Default |
|----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|---------|
| `{$PBS.URL.HOST}`                | Hostname or IP of the PBS API host                | -       |
| `{$PBS.URL.PORT}`                | PBS API port                                      | `8007`  |
| `{$PBS.TOKEN.ID}`                | API token ID (e.g. `monitor@pbs!zabbix`)          | -       |
| `{$PBS.TOKEN.SECRET}`            | API token secret                                  | -       |
| `{$PBS.DATASTORE.PUSE.MAX.WARN}` | Datastore used space warning threshold (%)        | `90`    |
| `{$PBS.BACKUP.AGE.WARN}`         | Max age of latest backup in seconds before warning| `90000` |
| `{$PBS.CPU.UTIL.MAX.WARN}`       | Host CPU utilization warning threshold (%)        | `90`    |
| `{$PBS.MEMORY.UTIL.MAX.WARN}`    | Host memory utilization warning threshold (%)     | `90`    |
| `{$PBS.ROOT.PUSE.MAX.WARN}`      | Root filesystem utilization warning threshold (%) | `90`    |

`{$PBS.DATASTORE.PUSE.MAX.WARN}` and `{$PBS.BACKUP.AGE.WARN}` support per-datastore context, e.g.
`{$PBS.BACKUP.AGE.WARN:"backup-fast"}`.

### 4. Verify
After a couple of polling intervals the host should report the API status, host metrics and the
discovered datastores in **Monitoring -> Latest data**. The *Estimated full date* item stays at `0`
until PBS has collected enough usage history (roughly a month) to compute the projection; this is
expected on a fresh datastore.
